scientific_question: Does the already generated full-item-span intervention carry a content-bound enumeration state beyond first-city adoption, and can the exact native-aligned representation panels be visualized without changing any frozen V6 selection?

provenance_disclosure.schema_smoke_row_scope: The first receiver_self row of Qwen3-8B enumeration_bullet forward_skip was inspected only to verify that completion_text and generated ordinal lists were retained. Its observed continuation is therefore disclosed and V3 remains a post-hoc robustness analysis, not a prospective confirmatory experiment.
provenance_disclosure.qualification: All V3 multihop claims must be labelled POSTHOC_AGGREGATE_REPARSE_AFTER_ONE_SCHEMA_SMOKE_ROW. The 3D panels are descriptive views of discovery-fitted projections and are not causal evidence.

full_item_span_multihop_reparse.donor_expected_sequence: The consecutive gold occurrence ordinals donor_occurrence + 1 through gold_count, in order.
full_item_span_multihop_reparse.receiver_expected_sequence: The consecutive gold occurrence ordinals receiver_occurrence + 1 through gold_count, in order.
full_item_span_multihop_reparse.prefix_rule: Starting at the first generated known-city ordinal, count the longest exact prefix matching the relevant expected sequence; do not skip, reorder, or repair generated ordinals.
full_item_span_multihop_reparse.primary_estimand: paired mean(donor_to_receiver donor-prefix-depth>=4 - receiver_self donor-prefix-depth>=4), seed clustered and direction averaged within cell
secondary_outcomes: conditional donor depth-2 and depth-4 persistence among donor_to_receiver rows with depth-1 adoption
full_item_span_multihop_reparse.denominator_rule: All ten frozen seeds in each direction remain in every unconditional denominator. Truncated, empty, ambiguous, duplicate, or nonmatching generations score zero for unmet registered depths and are reported separately.
full_item_span_multihop_reparse.strong_alignment_gate: For a cell, the primary paired depth-4 effect passes only if its 95% bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero; individual directions and conditional persistence remain descriptive.
full_item_span_multihop_reparse.no_new_forward_eligibility: If every frozen trials.jsonl contains all conditions, all ten seeds, completion_text, generation_truncated, and generated_known_city_ordinals_any_surface, no new model generation is permitted.

representation_3d.cells: all four model x grammar cells
representation_3d.layers: all captured post-block layers; the native-aligned discovery-selected layer is the default selector value
representation_3d.transform: For each endpoint, cell, and layer independently: fit StandardScaler and deterministic PCA(n_components=3, svd_solver=full, whiten=false) on discovery states only; flip each axis only when its discovery coordinate-label correlation is finite and negative; project confirmation states without refitting.
representation_3d.display: Show every confirmation point, connect confirmation label centroids in ordinal order, expose grammar/model/layer selectors, synchronize drag rotation between the running and final panels, and display explained-variance ratio. Axes are arbitrary PCA coordinates.
representation_3d.selection_firewall: No 3D coordinate, confirmation label, or visual appearance may alter a frozen selected layer or any inferential gate.

report_replication_contract.topology: Mirror the Native-thinking report's narrative mechanism sequence and evidence hierarchy while retaining Enumeration-specific Index/Bullet contrasts and every V6/V2/V3 result.
required_content: full-state direct and multihop commit-to-query continuation
Index versus Bullet and Native-thinking comparison matrix
limitations, claim ledger, source hashes, and audit appendices
report_replication_contract.asset_policy: Single self-contained HTML with no external runtime or CDN dependency.
report_replication_contract.outcome_policy: Scientific alignment means matching the experiment matrix and reporting standard, not forcing the same sign or significance. Every null and failure remains visible.
